svg.title: OSDU Delivery: Container diagram for OSDU Delivery, every path to an AI model
svg.desc: Only people's questions reach a model: no flow, mapping, render or delivery calls one, and every assistant follows the MCP server's rules.
svg.text: Container diagram for OSDU Delivery, every path to an AI model
Only people's questions reach a model: no flow, mapping, render or delivery calls one, and every assistant follows the MCP server's rules.

g.title: Data operator: Triggers and watches runs, follows a record from its source file and row to the OSDU id and version it landed as, releases, redelivers or removes records, reads assertion reports and asks the assistant.

Anthropic API: Always Anthropic, whatever the assistant's provider: synonym expansion of a ! question (find_similar_questions) and the questions a repository sync generates for report visuals. Both stay off without an Anthropic key.

AI model provider: The chat model behind the GUI assistant and Explain: a Foundry deployment (gpt-5.1 in the shipped environments), or OpenAI or Anthropic by setting, plus an optional transcription deployment for voice. Off on a fresh deployment; no flow, mapping, render or delivery ever calls a model.

AI coding assistants: An assistant a person runs (Claude Code, the VS Code chat, Cursor, Codex). It calls the MCP server with the person's own token, so it can do what that person can do, and what it does is recorded as theirs.

Pipeline developer: Writes the estate's flows, mappings, templates, schedules, assertions and AI contexts in VS Code, checks and previews them against the synced estate, and pushes them to the estate repository.

Workbench GUI: SQLFlow's workbench with the module's pages registered through the GUI module contract: pipelines and runs, lineage, the ledger and its records, the explorer of what OSDU holds, assertions, dimensions, inventories, templates, caches and the chat assistant. A static single-page app served by nginx; it calls the control plane's API.

Control plane: SQLFlow's control plane (.NET 9) with DeliveryControlPlaneModule: the REST API (the delivery API under /api/v1/delivery), identity and tokens, the managed git sync, schedules, the run queue and dispatcher, the node protocol, the chat assistant, and the module's background services. It decides what runs and owns the state; it runs no flow itself.
g.text: API, sign-in, sync, schedules, run queue, node

g.title: MCP server: osdu-delivery-mcp, a Model Context Protocol server: SQLFlow's server composed with the delivery module. Every assistant reads its instructions; it answers from metadata, and from data only for a ! question through a read-only query over what an approved AI context opens. It holds no credential: it forwards each caller's token.

Slack assistant: SQLFlow's Slack bot (Socket Mode). It answers through the same gateways and MCP server, under the same fence as the GUI chat, and marks every answer as AI-generated. No template of this product deploys it.

Catalog database: OsduDelivery: SQLFlow's catalog (pipelines, runs, schedules, lineage, users, conversations) and, beside it, the osdu schema with its own migrations: the ledger, the audit trail, cache versions, the index of the repository's templates, partitions and the central configuration.

Compute node: SqlFlow.Delivery.Worker.Host: SQLFlow's worker with the module installed. It takes its work outbound from the control plane, so it can sit next to the data, and reads and writes the ledger in the osdu schema through the catalog's connection.
g.text: Pulls runs; executes the file, ing

g.title: Ingestion database: OsduData: the pre tables a file flow lands its files into, the keyed ingestion tables an ing flow upserts (stamping UpdatedDate_DW) and a delivery flow reads incrementally, and the tables dimension flows build. Snapshot isolation must be on.

Calls or serves an AI model
